scene: A nightly load that dies part way through the export, is restarted, loses a commit, and is restarted again until it finishes.

attempts.label: first-attempt
attempts.note: the export feed drops out part way through the night's export

attempts.label: resume-after-restart
attempts.note: the warehouse loses a commit while the restart is running

attempts.label: resume-to-completion
attempts.note: a clean restart with nothing going wrong

scheduler: SourceInterrupted and StorageFailure both come out of the substrate on nights like this one, and the run is the thing that catches them: an attempt that reports interrupted is restarted five minutes later, an attempt that reports completed ends the night, and an attempt that hands back the exception instead of a report is paged to the on-call engineer and is not restarted, which is how a dropped feed turns into a morning of stale catalogue.
